title: Warehouse Lineage Record
description: Minimal first-pass schema for artifact lineage. Every canonical artifact must carry a lineage record. No artifact family reaches final canon without provenance and lineage fields.

artifact_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this artifact instance. Recommended format: <artifact-family>/<slug>@<version> or a UUID.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of most recent authoritative update.

created_by.description: Identity of the originating actor (human operator handle, agent ID, or system name).

authority_source.description: Canonical path or URI of the single authority location for this artifact family.

derived_from.description: List of artifact_id values that this artifact was derived from or synthesized from.

supersedes.description: List of artifact_id values that this artifact explicitly supersedes.

reflection_sources.description: Paths or URIs of non-authoritative mirrors or reflections. These are recovery surfaces only, not truth.

hash.description: Content hash of the artifact payload at time of record creation (SHA-256 hex recommended).

decision_refs.description: List of CANONIZATION_DECISIONS.md IDs that govern this artifact.

notes.description: Free-text provenance notes, ambiguity flags, or recovery context.
